title: Prefer `prefixmatch` over `match`
author: InSyncWithFoo
body_preview: ### Summary  Python 3.15 [introduces](https://docs.python.org/3.15/whatsnew/3.15.html#re) `re.prefixmatch` as a more explicit-sounding alias of `re.match`. The rule should also suggest `re.search` in its description, as that might have been what the user intended. Violations are always trivially and safely fixable.
